messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: extract in rstan
parts:
The chains object in C++ implements this the
way Andrew wants and RStan should, too.

Almost, anyway.

To be precise, both runs will produce consistent
orderings for mu_sim and tau_sim, but unless you
specify the same random seed for the permutation,
you won't necessarily get the very same result
from running them multiple times across sessions.

- Bob

On 11/5/12 3:12 PM, Andrew Gelman wrote:
> Jiqiang:
> Could we make permuted=TRUE the default? It seems to me that is what we will usually want to do. Also, in the help file it should be explained that, when we do permuted=TRUE, the permeation is chosen just once. (Actually, it should be part of the stan object in R.) People should realize that if they pull out different variables at different times, they will still be consistent with each other. Thus, the following two sets of commands should give the same results:
>
> a <- extract(fit2)
> mu_sim <- a$mu
> tau_sim <- a$tau
>
> or
>
> mu_sim <- extract(fit2)$mu
> tau_sim <- extract(fit2)$tau
>
> Thx
> A
>
> P.S. I'm ccing Bob just in case there's some reason he does not like this idea!
>
